reviews.title: Solid performer
reviews.comment: Solid performer. Easy to install. The semi-modular aspect let's me use just the connections that I need without cluttering my case. Quiet. No issues supporting an over-clocked CPU and 4k graphics card.

reviews.title: Solid 4 stars
reviews.comment: It's only been a few days since I installed this in my new rig, but so far so good. It's much easier to cable manage than non-modular power supplies usually are. I'm only using 2 of the modular cables, one for SATA and the other for my PCIe power. There's been zero issues with either one from the start, so the other two cables stayed right in the box. I'm glad i went with the 700 Watt for the power overhead, so even at full draw, it shouldn't max out or strain this PSU.
reviews.author: Lamont S.

reviews.title: Why 5 Stars? Because of the Price  and I have never had one break.
reviews.comment: Why 5 Stars? Because of the Price  and I have never had one break. Is it "the best" - NO. Is it sold at an amazing price? - YES.  Has it broken? - NO I have bought at least 10 of these and I have not had one break or go out on me yet. I'm  sure that there are better PSUs out there, in fact  I have bought better ones AT TWICE OR Even 3X the Price, however, this one has not broken down and I've made at least 10 PC's using this PSU.
reviews.author: Byron Young
